reason_zh: 三份已授权的 2026-09-02 Research Object 已转换为完整双语 Editorial Architecture 2.1 候选，具备已核验的规划工件、有边界的证据声明和确定性基础题图。

candidates.title: Token Budget Is Not Working-Memory Evidence
candidates.title_zh: 令牌预算，不是工作记忆的证据
candidates.researchQuestion: 长期运行的数字员工应如何证明其工作记忆有效，而不是只证明没有超过令牌预算？
candidates.coreProposition: Working-memory governance must evaluate stored state, delivered context, management work, and task/process outcome separately; nominal token budget or final success cannot substitute for layer-specific, version-bound evidence.

sections.heading: Equal Budgets Can Deliver Different Information
sections.heading_zh: 同样的预算，送达的信息可能完全不同

sections.heading: Four Layers Support Four Different Claims
sections.heading_zh: 四层证据支持四类不同主张

sections.heading: A New Policy Cannot Inherit an Old Qualification
sections.heading_zh: 策略更新不能继承旧版本的资格

sections.heading: Final Success Cannot Replace Process Evidence
sections.heading_zh: 最终成功不能替代过程证据

evidenceClaims.claim: The primary study analyzes 55 archived coding-agent trajectories and separates working-memory evidence into four layers.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 一手研究分析 55 条编程智能体轨迹，并把工作记忆证据拆成四层。

evidenceClaims.claim: Nominally equal budgets can correspond to unequal delivered context and management cost.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 相同名义预算可能对应不同的实际送达内容和管理成本。

evidenceClaims.claim: Some reported calibration improvements do not transfer to held-out tasks.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 部分报告的校准收益没有迁移到保留任务。

evidenceClaims.claim: Memory-policy qualification should bind the emitted version, actual delivery behavior and evaluated workload distribution.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 记忆策略资格应绑定实际生成版本、送达行为与被评估工作负载分布。

projectRelevance.rationale: The argument concerns general working-memory governance.

communityEdition.rationale: The complete Research Center edition already carries the transferable argument.

candidates.title: Installed Is Not Authorized
candidates.researchQuestion: 企业智能体执行连接器调用前，必须绑定哪些权限身份与决策？
candidates.coreProposition: Connector governance must keep administrative availability, configured capability, acting principal/account, target-resource permission, runtime policy and provider effect evidence separate; installation or enablement cannot authorize a call by itself.

sections.heading: Availability and Authority Answer Different Questions
sections.heading_zh: 可用性和授权回答不同的问题

sections.heading: The Account Link Is Part of the Claim
sections.heading_zh: 账户关联是授权主张的一部分

sections.heading: Six Layers Form a Bounded Authority Chain
sections.heading_zh: 六层构成有边界的权限链

sections.heading: Authorization Is Not an Effect Receipt
sections.heading_zh: 授权决定不是效果回执

sections.heading: One Indicator Can Still Exist
sections.heading_zh: 单一状态仍然可以存在

evidenceClaims.claim: OpenAI Epic documentation separates organizational setup from user sign-in, approved scopes and existing patient-record permissions.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: OpenAI Epic 文档把组织设置与用户登录、批准范围和既有病历权限分开。

evidenceClaims.claim: Microsoft documents configured Entra Agent ID connector permissions and runtime revalidation through connector policy and DLP controls.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Microsoft 记录了 Entra Agent ID 连接器权限以及连接器策略与 DLP 的运行时重新验证。

evidenceClaims.claim: The cited Codex revision includes selected account-link and tool identity in application-tool policy evaluation.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 引用的 Codex 版本把所选账户关联与工具身份纳入应用工具策略判断。

evidenceClaims.claim: Administrative enablement, actor identity, target permission, runtime policy and external effect are separate governance propositions.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 管理启用、行动身份、目标权限、运行时策略与外部效果是不同治理主张。

projectRelevance.rationale: The argument compares general connector-authority layers.

communityEdition.rationale: A separate edition would repeat the same comparative evidence.

candidates.title: A Smaller Skill Is Not the Same Skill
candidates.title_zh: 技能更小，不等于还是同一个技能
candidates.researchQuestion: 压缩或动态改写后的技能包要继续沿用原能力身份，必须保持哪些不变量？
candidates.coreProposition: Progressive skill compression must preserve public callable entries, route reachability, resource classifications and version/provenance; routing evidence is necessary but not sufficient for semantic, permission or effect equivalence.

sections.heading: A Skill Bundle Is a Routed Graph
The Numbers Support a Bounded Claim
sections.heading_zh: 数字只支持有边界的结论

sections.heading: Structural Preservation Needs Explicit Evidence
sections.heading_zh: 结构保留需要显式证据

sections.heading: Routing Is Necessary but Not Sufficient
sections.heading_zh: 路由正确是必要条件，不是充分条件

sections.heading: Adopt Candidates, Do Not Rewrite Identity in Place
sections.heading_zh: 采用候选，不要原地重写身份

evidenceClaims.claim: SkillZip Pro models skills as progressively loaded directory bundles.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: SkillZip Pro 把技能建模为渐进加载的目录包。

evidenceClaims.claim: The protected method reports about 38% bundle-token and 10.4% per-run reductions with no reported quality loss in its evaluated harness.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 受保护方法在评测中报告约 38% 的包令牌下降和 10.4% 的单次运行下降，且未报告质量损失。

evidenceClaims.claim: An aggressive 71% configuration loses up to 26 accuracy points, while the protected setup reports near-perfect route/public-entry preservation.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 71% 激进配置损失最高 26 个准确率百分点，而受保护设置报告近乎完全保留路由与公共入口。

evidenceClaims.claim: A compressed skill should retain its capability identity only after version-bound structural and behavioral evidence passes an adoption gate.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 压缩技能只有在版本绑定的结构与行为证据通过采用门禁后，才能保留原能力身份。

projectRelevance.rationale: The argument concerns general skill-bundle engineering.

communityEdition.rationale: The Research Center edition already provides the complete engineering argument.
